## TLDR
- **What:** one or two sentences: what changed.
- **Why:** the problem or need behind it.
- **How:** the approach in a few lines and the areas touched.

Refs #<!-- Refs #n while a check has to run after the merge (a release, a pre-release, the sandbox); Closes #n only when nothing does -->

## Decisions and questions
Questions asked on the issue with their answers, the design choices made and the alternative that was not taken.

## Change
Describe the resulting behavior and how it meets the linked issue.

## Verification
List the exact test command(s) run and their result, how each test criterion of the issue is covered (sandbox run URLs for workflow changes), and any remaining limitation. Tick the issue's boxes only for what is proven here.

## Not verified
What was not run (sandbox or AWS checks, release or pre-release steps) and why. Write "nothing" only when every test criterion of the issue was run.

## Risks and limitations
What could go wrong, what it does not cover, and what a reviewer should look at first.

## Checklist
- [ ] README / docs / examples updated if behavior or config changed
- [ ] No secrets or real account identifiers in the diff
